nodes.name: GameConfig.java
nodes.summary: Gson-deserialized game balance configuration (economy, wave scaling, explicit wave spawn lists) loaded from waves_config.json, with helpers for kill rewards, wave-clear rewards and per-wave enemy health/speed multipliers.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses public nested static POJO classes so Gson can map JSON directly onto fields without setters.

nodes.name: GameConfig
nodes.summary: Root config object with nested Economy, Scaling, SpawnDef and WaveDef classes plus balance helper methods.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Reads and parses the JSON config file with Gson, throwing IllegalStateException if it cannot be read.

nodes.name: explicitWave
nodes.summary: Returns the hand-defined wave definition for a wave number, or null if not explicitly listed.

nodes.name: killReward
nodes.summary: Coins awarded for killing an enemy type, defaulting to 5.

nodes.name: waveClearReward
nodes.summary: Coins awarded for clearing a wave: base reward plus a per-wave increment.

nodes.name: healthScale
nodes.summary: Computes the enemy health multiplier for a wave using linear per-wave growth plus periodic multiplicative jumps.

nodes.name: speedScale
nodes.summary: Computes the enemy speed multiplier for a wave, capped by speedCapPercent.

nodes.name: GameMap.java
nodes.summary: Loads the enemy path polyline from a CSV file and parameterizes positions by distance along the path; also decides where towers may be built by checking clearance from the track, decorative roads and obstacles.

nodes.name: GameMap
nodes.summary: Path model storing polyline points and cumulative segment lengths for distance-based enemy positioning and build validation.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Parses the path CSV (skipping header/blank lines), scales points to the map canvas and builds a GameMap.

nodes.name: GameMap
nodes.summary: Constructor that precomputes cumulative distances along the path and its total length.

nodes.name: getTotalLength
nodes.summary: Returns the total length of the enemy path.

nodes.name: getPoints
nodes.summary: Returns the path's polyline points.

nodes.name: getExtraRoads
nodes.summary: Returns decorative and dead-end road segments scaled to map coordinates for rendering.

nodes.name: pointAt
nodes.summary: Interpolates the (x, y) position at a given distance along the path.

nodes.name: distanceToPath
nodes.summary: Returns the shortest distance from a point to any segment of the enemy path.

nodes.name: canBuildAt
nodes.summary: Checks whether a tower may be placed at a point: inside bounds and clear of the path, extra roads and obstacles.

nodes.name: RunResult.java
nodes.summary: Immutable record summarizing a finished run (waves cleared, kills, cases opened, previous best, new-record flag) passed to the results screen.
nodes.languageNotes: Java record: compact immutable data carrier with auto-generated accessors, equals and hashCode.

nodes.name: RunResult
nodes.summary: Record of end-of-run statistics shown on the results screen.

nodes.name: PlayerDAO.java
nodes.summary: Data access object for the MySQL players table: looks up profiles by name, creates profiles on first login, and conditionally updates the highest score.
nodes.languageNotes: JDBC PreparedStatements with try-with-resources; the UPDATE's WHERE clause guards against lowering a stored best score.

nodes.name: PlayerDAO
nodes.summary: DAO wrapping JDBC queries against the players table.

nodes.name: findByName
nodes.summary: Selects a player by (case-insensitive) name and returns an Optional Player.

nodes.name: findOrCreate
nodes.summary: Returns the existing player for a name or inserts a new profile and returns it.

nodes.name: updateHighestScore
nodes.summary: Updates the stored highest score only when the new waves-cleared value is higher.

nodes.name: Player.java
nodes.summary: Simple player profile model holding id, name and highest score (waves cleared).

nodes.name: Player
nodes.summary: Player entity with id, name and highest score.

nodes.name: Player
nodes.summary: Constructs a player from database fields.

nodes.name: getPlayerId
nodes.summary: Returns the player's database id.

nodes.name: getPlayerName
nodes.summary: Returns the player's name.

nodes.name: getHighestScore
nodes.summary: Returns the player's best waves-cleared score.

nodes.name: setHighestScore
nodes.summary: Updates the in-memory highest score.

nodes.name: toString
nodes.summary: Formats the player for debug output.

nodes.name: AppController.java
nodes.summary: Top-level screen controller that wires the landing, game and results panels into the main frame, lazily loads catalog/config/map data, and handles navigation between screens.

nodes.name: AppController
nodes.summary: Controller owning the three screens and the shared game data.

nodes.name: AppController
nodes.summary: Creates the landing, game and results panels with callbacks and registers them on the main frame.

nodes.name: startRun
nodes.summary: Starts a run for the logged-in player after ensuring game data is loaded, then switches to the game screen.

nodes.name: loadData
nodes.summary: Lazily loads the catalog from MySQL and the JSON config and CSV map, showing an error dialog on failure.

nodes.name: GameButton.java
nodes.summary: Image-based clickable button component with a builder for size, position and icon, plus hover tracking and drawing.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the Builder pattern via a nested static Builder class.

nodes.name: GameButton
nodes.summary: Image button with bounds, hover state and a nested Builder.

nodes.name: GameButton
nodes.summary: Builds the button from a Builder's size, position and icon.

nodes.name: contains
nodes.summary: Hit-tests whether a point lies within the button.

nodes.name: updateHover
nodes.summary: Updates hover state from the mouse position.

nodes.name: isHovered
nodes.summary: Returns whether the mouse is over the button.

nodes.name: draw
nodes.summary: Paints the button icon, enlarged slightly when hovered.

nodes.name: TowerArt.java
nodes.summary: Static helper that draws a tower icon from its sprite when available, otherwise a placeholder shape colored by tower class.

nodes.name: TowerArt
nodes.summary: Non-instantiable helper for tower icon rendering.

nodes.name: classColor
nodes.summary: Maps a tower's class to its placeholder color.

nodes.name: draw
nodes.summary: Draws a tower sprite centered in a square, falling back to a class-colored placeholder shape.

nodes.name: GamePanel.java
nodes.summary: Main gameplay screen: runs a fixed-timestep game loop (1/60 s accumulator with x1/x2/x3 speed, paused while the shop is open), handles mouse/keyboard input for placing, selecting, upgrading and selling towers, renders the map, towers, enemies, effects and HUD, and saves new high scores when the run ends.
nodes.languageNotes: Swing Timer drives tick(); a time accumulator decouples simulation steps from repaint rate. Implements SidePanel.Actions as a callback interface.

nodes.name: GamePanel
nodes.summary: Swing gameplay panel combining game loop, input handling and rendering; implements SidePanel.Actions.

nodes.name: GamePanel
nodes.summary: Sets up size, mouse listeners and ESC/SPACE key bindings.

nodes.name: startRun
nodes.summary: Initializes a new GameSession, GameEngine and ShopOverlay for the player, resets state, loads the background and starts the timer.

nodes.name: advance
nodes.summary: Advances the simulation by real time using a fixed 1/60 s step and speed multiplier, pausing while the shop is open and finishing the run after game over.

nodes.name: finishRun
nodes.summary: Stops the loop, persists a new highest score via PlayerDAO if beaten, and reports a RunResult.

nodes.name: handlePress
nodes.summary: Routes mouse presses to the shop, side panel, quit button, tower placement or selection.

nodes.name: placeAt
nodes.summary: Places the currently selected inventory tower at a map position if allowed.

nodes.name: selectInventory
nodes.summary: Toggles placement mode for an inventory tower type.

nodes.name: sellInventory
nodes.summary: Shows a popup menu to sell one inventory copy of a tower type for coins.

nodes.name: upgradeSelected
nodes.summary: Upgrades the selected tower and shows a toast on success.

nodes.name: sellSelected
nodes.summary: Sells the selected placed tower.

nodes.name: openShop
nodes.summary: Opens the case shop overlay.

nodes.name: startWave
nodes.summary: Starts the next wave when the shop is closed and announces boss waves.

nodes.name: cycleSpeed
nodes.summary: Cycles the game speed between x1, x2 and x3.

nodes.name: paintComponent
nodes.summary: Top-level render pass drawing ground, path, grid, towers, enemies, effects, HUD, side panel, shop and banners.

nodes.name: paintGround
nodes.summary: Draws the background image or a checkerboard grass fallback.

nodes.name: paintPath
nodes.summary: Draws the enemy path and extra roads when no background image is present.

nodes.name: paintPlacementGrid
nodes.summary: Draws the placement grid while in tower placement mode.

nodes.name: paintGhost
nodes.summary: Draws a translucent preview of the tower being placed with its range and validity.

nodes.name: paintTowers
nodes.summary: Draws placed towers with sprites, range circles for the selection and support-tower turrets.

nodes.name: paintEnemy
nodes.summary: Draws an enemy with sprite rotation, status-effect tints and a health bar.

nodes.name: paintEnemyCircle
nodes.summary: Fallback enemy rendering as colored circles with status indicators.

nodes.name: paintEffect
nodes.summary: Draws fading line and circle visual effects such as shots and explosions.

nodes.name: pill
nodes.summary: Draws a rounded HUD label pill.

nodes.name: paintBanners
nodes.summary: Draws toast messages and the game-over banner.

nodes.name: LandingPanel.java
nodes.summary: Landing/menu screen where the player types a name, opens a crate to load or create their profile, and can view help or start a run; drawn from image assets with absolute-positioned buttons.

nodes.name: LandingPanel
nodes.summary: Landing screen panel with name entry, crate opening, play and help buttons.

nodes.name: LandingPanel
nodes.summary: Lays out the name field and help panel and wires mouse clicks to quit, crate, play and help actions.

nodes.name: openCrate
nodes.summary: Validates the name and loads or creates the player profile via PlayerDAO, then reveals the menu.

nodes.name: getPlayer
nodes.summary: Returns the loaded player profile, or null before the crate is opened.

nodes.name: getPlayerName
nodes.summary: Returns the trimmed name typed by the player.

nodes.name: paintComponent
nodes.summary: Paints either the start or menu screen depending on state.

nodes.name: paintStartScreen
nodes.summary: Draws the start screen background, logo, name box and crate.

nodes.name: paintMenuScreen
nodes.summary: Draws the menu with player name, highest score and play/help buttons.

nodes.name: drawText
nodes.summary: Draws centered outlined text within a box.

nodes.name: DbCheck.java
nodes.summary: Read-only command-line diagnostic that verifies the database connection and PlayerDAO lookups work.

nodes.name: DbCheck
nodes.summary: Standalone database diagnostic class.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Runs sample PlayerDAO lookups and prints results or the failure message.

nodes.name: SpriteLoader.java
nodes.summary: Cached loader for tower sprite images by path, returning null for missing files so placeholder art is drawn instead.

nodes.name: SpriteLoader
nodes.summary: Static sprite cache keyed by file path.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns a cached image for a path, reading it from disk on first request; null if missing or unreadable.
